palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed source gray head, orange beak/feet, purple torso/wings, red eye surround, yellow iris and source dark pupil in one approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr705 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies engine action names and events.
ground_policy_note: Grounded feet and fixed shadow row 47, with native wing movement and Hop/attack lift retained. No flying baseline offset.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native leg cycle with wing balance; duplicate endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised leg and forward contact with source wing support.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own fe02 hand/wing release gesture. fe04 throws widely displaced native shuriken and was not selected for the character-only sheet; no projectile invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting pose; source eyes remain open-looking, so no eyelids are drawn.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil with wing and head displacement.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native ba02 broad wing sweep. bs01 travels vertically out of the fixed PMDO cell and was rejected after two failed assemblies.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native strike cycles; engine XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own bf01 whole-body lift; fixed shadow exposes a gap, then feet return.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own crossed-wing preparation/strain, reverse-sampled to recover; no added effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gaze/wing motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; no duplicate endpoint.
